summary: Add free-form alert tagging with tag assignment endpoints, tag filtering, response projection, and relational schema support.

acceptance_criteria.text: Introduce a Tag concept with a many-to-many relationship to Alert, including the required persistence model and database migration artifacts.
POST /api/alerts/{id}/tags adds one or more tags for an existing alert, dedupes case-insensitively, enforces at most 10 tags per alert, and enforces each tag length to 1 through 30 characters.
DELETE /api/alerts/{id}/tags/{tag} removes a tag assignment and returns 404 when the alert does not exist or the tag is not assigned to that alert.
GET /api/alerts supports an optional tag query filter that composes with the existing isActive, severity, created date range, and search filters.
AlertResponse includes the alert's tags so tag assignments are visible in list and detail responses.

constraints: Keep the existing layered seam intact: controller -> service -> repository; controllers and services should continue working with DTOs instead of EF entities.
Normalize tag comparisons case-insensitively for assignment, removal, and filtering while preserving a deterministic returned tag shape.
Respect repository-wide existing filter composition and avoid regressing current paging, sorting, and search behavior on GET /api/alerts.
Fit the tag schema into the current EF Core SQL Server model and checked-in migration workflow.
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage for tag validation, case-insensitive dedupe, and max-10 enforcement on tag assignment.
Behavior coverage for tag removal not-found paths and successful removal.
Behavior coverage for GET /api/alerts tag filter composition with existing repository filters and AlertResponse tag projection.
